remarks: Welcome to Oakwood Common. This completely renovated condo is tastefully remodeled and newly complete. As you enter you see the expansive family room with sliders to deck, a wood burning fireplace wrapped in shiplap and tons of natural light. There is plenty of room for a large dining area as well. The kitchen is to die for! All new cabinets, stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops and a large window for additional natural light. To complete this floor is a powder room, again completely renovated. Upstairs, are two large bedrooms with en-suite baths and large closets. The washer/dryer are on this level as well. Below the condo is garage parking for one car and a private storage room to store your items. The location is hard to beat as the condo is steps from the Merritt 7 train and close to 95 and the Merritt Parkway. Excellent Credit and References a must.
